rationale: Record repair of Pulp-owned Scene3D CTest manifests and their renderer-golden manifest verifier call sites after the test manifest split left four files syntactically incomplete. The visual-proof-harness family is affected because two watched tools/**/*golden* verifier paths now read the split renderer3d probe manifest instead of the former monolithic test/CMakeLists.txt. Their validation policy and expected renderer evidence are unchanged. The accompanying parser checks cover every test/cmake manifest, including off-by-default Scene3D registrations, and include malformed-manifest negative controls. This is watch-only Pulp test infrastructure maintenance: no Vellum source, transferred slice, rendering behavior, golden baseline, acceptance artifact, or authority boundary changes.
tests: cmake test-manifest parse check across 96 manifests
